name: ammas-coimbatore
description: AMMAS Hotel App v2 - single-branch restaurant POS, kitchen, stock and owner reporting

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c green,yellow "npm run dev -w @ammas/server" "npm run dev -w @ammas/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @ammas/server && npm run build -w @ammas/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @ammas/server && npm run typecheck -w @ammas/web && npm run typecheck -w @ammas/print-bridge
